## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: "I'm frustrated when I can't determine if my packet was forwarded by mesh peers..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe how the new feature would work, its user-facing behavior, or API designs.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Mockups / Layouts (Optional)
If applicable, insert UI wireframes or diagram sketches here.

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
